title: EntityType
description: NGSI-LD EntityType data type (ETSI GS CIM 009 clause 5.2.25). An element of the detailed entity type list representation returned by GET /types?details=true (clause 4.5.11). Not subject to options=concise/keyValues.

id.description: Fully Qualified Name (FQN) of the entity type being described.

type.description: JSON-LD @type. It shall be equal to "EntityType".

attributeNames.description: List containing the names of attributes that instances of the entity type can have.

typeName.description: Name of the entity type; short name if contained in @context.
